angle.why_now: Steam opened a free-to-play window for Crusader Kings III on 19 Nov 2026 that runs to 23 Nov, with a 70 percent discount on the full game.
angle.what_it_means_here: Free to try this weekend, and the full game costs 57.30 AED on the UAE store.
